subject: general
question: What is the Neonatal Mortality Rate (per 1000 live births) as per the fifth round of National Family Health Survey (NFHS) conducted by Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) during the year 2019-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24.9**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Neonatal Mortality Rate** (per 1000 live births) as per the fifth round of National Family Health Survey (NFHS) conducted by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) during the year 2019-21 is **24.9**.
 
• The National Family Health Survey (NFHS) provides essential data on health and family welfare, and also highlights the impact of health policies.
 
• The survey is crucial for understanding the progress in various health indicators and helps in policy formulation and implementation.
 
• The **Neonatal Mortality Rate** is a critical indicator of the health status of newborns and the effectiveness of maternal and child health services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Family Health Survey (NFHS)** is conducted under the stewardship of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India.
 
• NFHS-5 (2019-21) is the fifth in the series which started in 1992-93.
 
• The survey covers a wide range of topics including fertility, maternal and child health, family planning, and nutrition.
 
• It also provides data on emerging health issues such as HIV/AIDS, non-communicable diseases, and domestic violence.
 
• NFHS data are used by researchers, policymakers, and program managers to make informed decisions.
